title: Immune Memory
description: Memory cells that outlive the fight and answer at once the next time, for years. Unlocks lasting Wards, held safe for good.

puzzle.goal: Memory falls off slowly, by a half-life T. Write the share S still protected after a time t.
puzzle.name: Slow decline
puzzle.ask: Find S for t = @{t} and T = @{T}.
puzzle.method: Each half-life halves the protection; a lasting Ward sets the half-life so high it never matters.
